create_place_cell_ensembles: create place cell ensembles for a neural network model with configurable environment size and neuron counts
create_head_direction_ensembles: create head direction cell ensembles for a neural network model with configurable concentration parameters
encode_initial_conditions: encode initial conditions for place cells and head direction cells as TensorFlow tensors

get_scores_and_plot: calculate neural activity scores and generate ratemap and autocorrelation plots for grid cell analysis
